fields.description: Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response. Use 'fields=*' to return all available fields for the permission resource.
fields.human_parameter_description: Choose which permission details to return. Use 'fields=*' for everything, or list specific fields (e.g., 'id,role,emailAddress') to keep the response concise.

file_id.title: File Id
file_id.description: The ID of the file.
file_id.human_parameter_description: The unique ID of the file whose permission you want to look up. You can copy it from the file's URL in Drive.

permission_id.title: Permission Id
permission_id.description: The numeric ID of the permission. Note: The 'me' alias is NOT supported by the Google Drive permissions API. You must provide an actual numeric permission ID (e.g., '12345678901234567890'). Use the LIST_PERMISSIONS action to get permission IDs for a file.
permission_id.human_parameter_description: The numeric permission ID to look up. Important: 'me' is NOT supported - you must use an actual permission ID. Use LIST_PERMISSIONS on the file first to get the permission IDs.

supports_all_drives.title: Supports All Drives
supports_all_drives.description: Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives.
supports_all_drives.human_parameter_description: Turn this on if the file might be in a shared drive. It ensures the request works for both My Drive and shared drives.

use_domain_admin_access.title: Use Domain Admin Access
use_domain_admin_access.description: Issue the request as a domain administrator; if set to true, then the requester will be granted access if the file ID parameter refers to a shared drive and the requester is an administrator of the domain to which the shared drive belongs.
use_domain_admin_access.human_parameter_description: Enable this if you are a Google Workspace domain admin and need to use admin privileges to access permissions on shared drive files.

id.title: Id
id.description: The ID of the permission. This is a unique identifier for the grantee, and is published in User resources as permissionId.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Identifies what kind of resource this is. Value: the fixed string "drive#permission".

role.title: Role
role.description: The role granted by this permission. While new values may be supported in the future, the following are currently possible: "owner", "organizer", "fileOrganizer", "writer", "commenter", "reader"

type.title: Type
type.description: The type of the grantee. Valid values are: "user", "group", "domain", "anyone"

view.title: View
view.description: Indicates the view for this permission. Only populated for permissions that belong to a view. published is the only supported value.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: The domain to which this permission refers.

deleted.title: Deleted
deleted.description: Whether the account associated with this permission has been deleted. This field only pertains to user and group permissions.

photoLink.title: Photo Link
photoLink.description: A link to the user's profile photo, if available.

link_label.title: Link Label
link_label.description: Human-readable label for the display URL link.

displayName.title: Display Name
displayName.description: A displayable name for users, groups or domains.

display_url.title: Display Url
display_url.description: URL to view the file in Google Drive web interface.

emailAddress.title: Email Address
emailAddress.description: The email address of the user or group to which this permission refers.

pendingOwner.title: Pending Owner
pendingOwner.description: Whether the user is a pending owner of the file. This is only applicable for user permissions for files that are not in a shared drive.

expirationTime.title: Expiration Time
expirationTime.description: The time at which this permission will expire (RFC 3339 date-time). Expiration times have the following restrictions: - They can only be set on user and group permissions - The time must be in the future - The time cannot be more than a year in the future

permissionDetails.title: Permission Details
permissionDetails.description: Output-only details about how the permission is applied for items in shared drives (formerly Team Drives). Indicates whether the permission is inherited or directly applied, and the effective roles. Present only for items in shared drives.

allowFileDiscovery.title: Allow File Discovery
allowFileDiscovery.description: Whether the permission allows the file to be discovered through search. This is only applicable for permissions of type domain or anyone.

teamDrivePermissionDetails.title: Team Drive Permission Details
teamDrivePermissionDetails.description: Deprecated. Use permissionDetails instead. Historically provided details for items in Team Drives (now shared drives), indicating whether permissions were inherited or directly applied and the effective roles.

inheritedPermissionsDisabled.title: Inherited Permissions Disabled
inheritedPermissionsDisabled.description: If true, only organizers, file organizers, and owners of the item can share or access the item. Read-only. This field only applies to items in shared drives.

role.title: Role
role.description: The primary role for this user as applied to the item.

inherited.title: Inherited
inherited.description: Whether this permission is inherited from a parent. Output only.

inheritedFrom.title: Inherited From
inheritedFrom.description: The ID of the item from which this permission is inherited. Populated only when the permission is inherited.

permissionType.title: Permission Type
permissionType.description: The type of permission this entry represents for the user. One of 'file' or 'member'.

additionalRoles.title: Additional Roles
additionalRoles.description: Additional roles for this user. Currently only 'commenter' is supported.

additionalRoles.title: Additional Roles
additionalRoles.description: Deprecated. Additional roles for this user in Team Drive (now shared drives). Currently only 'commenter' is supported.

error.title: Error
error.description: Error if any occurred during the execution of the action

successful.title: Successful
successful.description: Whether or not the action execution was successful or not

description: Gets a permission by ID. Use this tool to retrieve a specific permission for a file or shared drive. Newly created or updated permissions on shared drives may have a brief propagation delay before appearing.

name: Get Permission ID for Email

key.title: Key
key.description: API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.

email.title: Email
email.description: The email address for which to return a permission ID

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.

quotaUser.title: Quota User
quotaUser.description: Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.

oauth_token.title: Oauth Token
oauth_token.description: OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.

prettyPrint.title: Pretty Print
prettyPrint.description: Returns response with indentations and line breaks.

link_label.title: Link Label

display_url.description: URL to view in Google Drive.

presentation_id.title: Presentation Id
presentation_id.description: The Google Slides presentation ID from its URL, not its title.

width.title: Width
width.description: The presentation page width.

unit.title: Unit

magnitude.title: Magnitude
magnitude.description: The dimension magnitude in the specified unit.

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: The presentation locale as an IETF BCP 47 language tag.

slides.title: Slides
slides.description: Slides with their properties and complete page-element structures.

layouts.title: Layouts
layouts.description: Layout pages with their properties and complete page-element structures.

masters.title: Masters
masters.description: Master pages with their properties and complete page-element structures.

pageSize.title: Page Size
pageSize.description: The width and height shared by pages in the presentation.

notesMaster.title: Notes Master
notesMaster.description: The notes master, preserving its properties and page elements.

presentationId.title: Presentation Id
presentationId.description: The unique identifier of the presentation.

error.title: Error
error.description: Error if any occurred during the execution of the action

successful.title: Successful
successful.description: Whether or not the action execution was successful or not

name: Get Presentation Page Thumbnail

mime_type.title: Mime Type
mime_type.description: Thumbnail image format. Google currently supports only PNG.

page_object_id.title: Page Object Id
page_object_id.description: The object ID of the slide, master, layout, notes page, or notes master to render. Obtain slide IDs from GOOGLEDRIVE_GET_PRESENTATION slides[].objectId.

thumbnail_size.title: Thumbnail Size
thumbnail_size.description: Maximum thumbnail width while preserving aspect ratio: LARGE is 1600 px, MEDIUM is 800 px, and SMALL is 200 px.

presentation_id.title: Presentation Id
presentation_id.description: The Google Slides presentation ID from its URL, not its title.

width.title: Width
width.description: Thumbnail width in pixels.

contentUrl.title: Content Url
contentUrl.description: Access-bearing thumbnail URL, normally valid for about 30 minutes. Treat it as short-lived and do not publish or store it as a durable URL.

error.title: Error
error.description: Error if any occurred during the execution of the action

successful.title: Successful
successful.description: Whether or not the action execution was successful or not

name: Get Reply

fileId.title: File Id
fileId.description: The ID of the file.
fileId.human_parameter_description: The unique ID of the file that contains the comment. You can find it in the file's URL in Google Drive.

replyId.title: Reply Id
replyId.human_parameter_description: The unique identifier of the specific reply you want to retrieve. You can get it from a previous list of replies or an earlier action's output.

commentId.title: Comment Id
commentId.human_parameter_description: The identifier of the comment that this reply belongs to. Use the ID you got from creating the comment or listing comments on the file.

includeDeleted.title: Include Deleted
includeDeleted.description: Whether to return deleted replies. Deleted replies will not include their original content.
includeDeleted.human_parameter_description: Choose whether to include replies that have been deleted. Turn this on if you need to confirm a reply existed even though its content is removed.

me.title: Me
me.description: Whether this user is the authenticated user.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Identifies the type of resource; always "drive#user".

photoLink.title: Photo Link
photoLink.description: A link to the user's profile photo, if available.

displayName.title: Display Name
displayName.description: A plain text display name for this user.

emailAddress.title: Email Address
emailAddress.description: The email address of the user. May not be present for all users.

permissionId.title: Permission Id
permissionId.description: The user's permission ID, if available.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Identifies the type of resource; always "drive#reply".

action.title: Action
action.description: The action this reply performed on the parent comment. Can be one of: "resolve" or "reopen".

author.title: Author
author.description: The author of the reply.

content.title: Content
content.description: The plain text content of the reply. May be absent for deleted replies.

deleted.title: Deleted
deleted.description: Whether the reply has been deleted. A deleted reply has no content.

link_label.title: Link Label
link_label.description: Label for the display URL link

createdTime.title: Created Time
createdTime.description: The time at which the reply was created (RFC 3339 format).

display_url.title: Display Url
display_url.description: URL to view the comment reply in Google Drive

htmlContent.title: Html Content
htmlContent.description: The content of the reply with HTML formatting. May be absent for deleted replies.

modifiedTime.title: Modified Time
modifiedTime.description: The time at which the reply was last modified (RFC 3339 format).

error.title: Error
error.description: Error if any occurred during the execution of the action

successful.title: Successful
successful.description: Whether or not the action execution was successful or not

description: Tool to get a specific reply to a comment on a file. Use when you need to retrieve the details of a particular reply.

name: Get Revision

file_id.title: File Id
file_id.description: The ID of the file.
file_id.human_parameter_description: Enter the ID of the file whose revision you want to view. You can copy it from the file's URL or from a previous search or list step.

revision_id.title: Revision Id
revision_id.human_parameter_description: Enter the ID of the specific revision of the file you want details for. You can get this from a prior 'list revisions' step or other metadata lookup.

acknowledge_abuse.title: Acknowledge Abuse
acknowledge_abuse.description: Whether the user is acknowledging the risk of downloading known malware or other abusive files. This is only applicable when the alt parameter is set to media and the user is the owner of the file or an organizer of the shared drive in which the file resides.
acknowledge_abuse.human_parameter_description: Turn this on only if you understand the file may be unsafe and you still want to proceed. Enable it when you're sure you trust the source and need to access the file.

me.title: Me
me.description: Whether this user is the requesting user.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Identifies the type of user resource. Always 'drive#user'.

photoLink.title: Photo Link
photoLink.description: A link to the user's profile photo.

displayName.title: Display Name
displayName.description: A plain text displayable name for this user.

emailAddress.title: Email Address
emailAddress.description: The email address of the user. May not be present for all users.

permissionId.title: Permission Id
permissionId.description: The permission ID for this user, suitable for use in the permissions API.

id.title: Id
id.description: The unique identifier of the revision. May be numeric-like for Google Workspace files or an opaque string for binary files.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Identifies the type of resource. For revisions, this is always 'drive#revision'.

size.title: Size
size.description: The size of the revision's content in bytes. Returned as a string representing a 64-bit integer. Applicable only to files with binary content in Drive.

mimeType.title: Mime Type
mimeType.description: The MIME type of the revision.

published.title: Published
published.description: Whether this revision is published. Applicable only to Docs Editors files.

link_label.title: Link Label
link_label.description: Human-readable label for the display URL.

display_url.title: Display Url
display_url.description: URL to view the file in Google Drive, routed based on MIME type.

exportLinks.title: Export Links
exportLinks.description: A map of export formats to URLs for exporting the revision of a Docs Editors file. Keys are MIME types; values are URLs.

keepForever.title: Keep Forever
keepForever.description: Whether to keep this revision forever, even if it is no longer the head revision. If not set, this revision may be automatically purged 30 days after newer content is uploaded. Applicable only to files with binary content in Drive. A maximum of 200 revisions per file can be kept forever.

md5Checksum.title: Md5 Checksum
md5Checksum.description: The MD5 checksum of the revision's content. Applicable only to files with binary content in Drive.

publishAuto.title: Publish Auto
publishAuto.description: Whether subsequent revisions will be automatically republished. Applicable only to Docs Editors files.

modifiedTime.title: Modified Time
modifiedTime.description: The last time the revision was modified (RFC 3339 date-time).

publishedLink.title: Published Link
publishedLink.description: A link to the published revision. Populated only for Google Sites files.

originalFilename.title: Original Filename
originalFilename.description: The original filename used to create this revision. Applicable only to files with binary content in Drive.

lastModifyingUser.title: Last Modifying User
lastModifyingUser.description: Information about the last user who modified this revision.

publishedOutsideDomain.title: Published Outside Domain
publishedOutsideDomain.description: Whether this revision is published outside the domain. Applicable only to Docs Editors files.

error.title: Error
error.description: Error if any occurred during the execution of the action

successful.title: Successful
successful.description: Whether or not the action execution was successful or not

description: Tool to get a specific revision's metadata (name, modifiedTime, keepForever, etc.) by revision ID. Returns metadata only — not file content. Use a separate download tool to retrieve file content or restore a revision.

name: Get Spreadsheet

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Google partial-response selector, for example 'spreadsheetId,properties(title),sheets(properties(sheetId,title))'. Omit for Google's full normal response. When present it overrides include_grid_data behavior; explicitly select sheets.data or descendants to receive grid data.

ranges.title: Ranges
ranges.description: Up to 10 A1 ranges whose sheet data should be returned. Use bounded ranges such as 'Sheet1!A1:D100'; omit to address the whole spreadsheet resource.

spreadsheet_id.title: Spreadsheet Id
spreadsheet_id.description: The spreadsheet ID from its Google Sheets URL, not its title or full URL.

include_grid_data.title: Include Grid Data
include_grid_data.description: Include cell grid data for the requested ranges. This can produce a large response. When fields is supplied, Google ignores includeGridData, so this query parameter is omitted and the fields mask must select sheets.data descendants.

exclude_tables_in_banded_ranges.title: Exclude Tables In Banded Ranges
exclude_tables_in_banded_ranges.description: Exclude table data embedded in banded ranges from the response. Leave false to include it.

sheets.title: Sheets
sheets.description: Sheets with their complete properties and structures. Grid row data is present only when selected by include_grid_data or fields.

properties.title: Properties
properties.description: Spreadsheet-wide properties such as title, locale, time zone, default format, and theme.

dataSources.title: Data Sources
dataSources.description: External data sources connected to the spreadsheet.

namedRanges.title: Named Ranges
namedRanges.description: Named ranges defined in the spreadsheet.

spreadsheetId.title: Spreadsheet Id
spreadsheetId.description: The spreadsheet ID; absent when excluded by fields.

error.title: Error
error.description: Error if any occurred during the execution of the action

successful.title: Successful
successful.description: Whether or not the action execution was successful or not

description: Retrieve a Google Spreadsheet's structure, metadata, and selected grid data.

name: Get Spreadsheet Values

range.title: Range
range.description: An A1 or R1C1 range to read, such as 'Sheet1!A1:D100'. Prefer a bounded range; whole-sheet or whole-column ranges can return very large responses.

spreadsheet_id.title: Spreadsheet Id
spreadsheet_id.description: The spreadsheet ID from its Google Sheets URL, not its title.

major_dimension.title: Major Dimension
major_dimension.description: Whether the outer values array represents rows or columns. If omitted, Google defaults to ROWS.

value_render_option.title: Value Render Option
value_render_option.description: How cell values are rendered: formatted display values, unformatted calculated values, or formulas.

date_time_render_option.title: Date Time Render Option
date_time_render_option.description: How dates, times, and durations are rendered when value_render_option is UNFORMATTED_VALUE.

range.title: Range
range.description: The A1 range covered by the returned values, including the sheet name.

values.title: Values
values.description: Cell values grouped by the major dimension. Values may be strings, numbers, booleans, or null; trailing empty rows and columns are omitted.

majorDimension.title: Major Dimension
majorDimension.description: Whether the outer values array represents rows or columns.

error.title: Error
error.description: Error if any occurred during the execution of the action

successful.title: Successful
successful.description: Whether or not the action execution was successful or not

pageToken.description: The token for continuing a previous list request on the next page. Must be a valid token from a previous LIST_CHANGES response's 'nextPageToken' field or from the get_changes_start_page_token action. If not provided, the current start page token will be automatically fetched and used. Tokens can become stale — always use a fresh token from GOOGLEDRIVE_GET_CHANGES_START_PAGE_TOKEN or the most recent prior response to avoid missed or duplicate changes. Paginate until nextPageToken is absent; stopping early silently omits changes.

includeCorpusRemovals.title: Include Corpus Removals
includeCorpusRemovals.description: Whether changes should include the file resource if the file is still accessible by the user at the time of the request, even when a file was removed from the list of changes and there will be no further change entries for this file. Note: When set to true, includeRemoved must also be true (will be automatically set).
includeCorpusRemovals.human_parameter_description: Turn this on to also return items that were removed from the change feed but that you can still access, so you can see their current details.

includeItemsFromAllDrives.title: Include Items From All Drives
includeItemsFromAllDrives.description: Whether both My Drive and shared drive items should be included in results. Must be true when driveId is specified (will be automatically set to true when driveId is provided).

q.description: A query string for filtering the file results. Supports operators 'and', 'or', 'not'. VALID query terms: 'name' (contains, =, !=), 'fullText' (contains), 'mimeType' (contains, =, !=), 'modifiedTime' (<=, <, =, !=, >, >=), 'viewedByMeTime' (<=, <, =, !=, >, >=), 'trashed' (=, !=), 'starred' (=, !=), 'parents' (in), 'owners' (in), 'writers' (in), 'readers' (in), 'sharedWithMe' (=, !=), 'createdTime' (<=, <, =, !=, >, >=), 'properties' (has), 'appProperties' (has), 'visibility' (=, !=), 'shortcutDetails.targetId' (=, !=). IMPORTANT: 'id' is NOT a valid query term - you cannot search by file ID using this parameter. To get a specific file by ID, use the 'Get File Metadata' action instead. Example: "name contains 'important' and mimeType = 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder'".

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Selector specifying which file fields to include in the response. Provide a comma-separated list of file field names (e.g., 'id,name,mimeType,webViewLink'). The action will automatically format this into the proper API format 'files(field1,field2,...)'. Common file fields include: id, name, description, mimeType, webViewLink, webContentLink, size, createdTime, modifiedTime, parents, owners, permissions. To also include the pagination token, add 'nextPageToken' to the list. NOTE: Google Drive API v2 field names are automatically converted to v3 equivalents (e.g., alternateLink→webViewLink, downloadUrl→webContentLink, title→name, createdDate→createdTime, modifiedDate→modifiedTime).

IMPORTANT: Use 'quotaBytesUsed' to sort by file size (do NOT use 'size' - it is not a valid key). Each key sorts in ascending order by default, but can be reversed with the 'desc' modifier (e.g., 'modifiedTime desc').

description: Moves a file to another Google Drive folder. At least one of `add_parents` or `remove_parents` is required; calls with neither are rejected. Supply `add_parents` with the destination folder ID; if `remove_parents` is omitted, the action checks and removes the current parent automatically before adding the destination. For My Drive files only, `remove_parents` without `add_parents` moves the file to My Drive root. For shared-drive items, set `supports_all_drives=true` and provide `add_parents` because the item must retain exactly one parent; membership, role, and domain policies can restrict moves, and the Drive API cannot move a folder from My Drive into a shared drive. Google Drive files have one parent, so use a shortcut for additional placements.

remove_parents.title: Remove Parents

IMPORTANT: Use folder IDs (like '1A2B3C4D5E6F7G8H9I0J'), NOT folder names (like 'My Folder'). You can find folder IDs in the URL when viewing a folder in Google Drive, or by listing/searching folders first. Separate multiple IDs with commas.

writers_can_share.title: Writers Can Share

supports_all_drives.title: Supports All Drives

keep_revision_forever.title: Keep Revision Forever

keep_revision_forever.human_parameter_description: Pin this version of the file so it’s never automatically cleaned up. Helpful when you need to preserve a specific snapshot.

use_domain_admin_access.title: Use Domain Admin Access
use_domain_admin_access.description: Whether the requesting application is using domain-wide delegation to access content belonging to a user in a different domain. This is only applicable to files with binary content in Google Drive.
use_domain_admin_access.human_parameter_description: Enable only if you’re a domain admin acting on behalf of another user. Lets you perform the update across your organization’s Drive.

viewers_can_copy_content.title: Viewers Can Copy Content
viewers_can_copy_content.description: Whether viewers are prevented from copying content of the file.
viewers_can_copy_content.human_parameter_description: Choose whether viewers are allowed to copy or download the file’s content. Turn on to block copying.

description: Updates file metadata. Uses PATCH semantics (partial update) as per Google Drive API v3 — only explicitly provided fields are updated, so omit fields you do not intend to overwrite. Use this tool to modify attributes of an existing file like its name, description, or parent folders. To move a file, supply add_parents and remove_parents together; omitting remove_parents creates multiple parents, omitting add_parents can orphan the file. Bulk updates may trigger 429 Too Many Requests; apply exponential backoff. Note: supports metadata updates only; file content updates are not yet implemented.

description: Updates ONLY the metadata properties of a specific file revision (keepForever, published, publishAuto, publishedOutsideDomain). IMPORTANT: This action does NOT update file content. To update file content, use EDIT_FILE or UPDATE_FILE_PUT instead. This action requires BOTH file_id AND revision_id parameters. Use LIST_REVISIONS to get available revision IDs for a file. Valid parameters: file_id (required), revision_id (required), keep_forever, published, publish_auto, published_outside_domain. Invalid parameters (use other actions): file_contents, mime_type, content, name - these are NOT supported by this action.

enforceExpansiveAccess.description: Whether the request should enforce expansive access rules. This field is deprecated, it is recommended to use `permissionDetails` instead.
enforceExpansiveAccess.human_parameter_description: If enabled, uses broader access rules when applying the update. Generally leave this off unless you know you need it.

id.title: Id
id.description: A unique string that identifies this channel. UUIDs are recommended. Must be unique per active channel; reusing an ID can cause missed, delayed, or duplicate notifications.

type.title: Type
type.description: The type of delivery mechanism for notifications.
type.human_parameter_description: How you want to receive notifications. Most users should choose 'web_hook' to send updates to a URL you control.

token.title: Token
token.description: An arbitrary string that will be delivered with each notification. Can be used for verification.
token.human_parameter_description: Optional secret string that will be included with each notification. Use it to verify that notifications came from your subscription.

params.title: ChannelParams
params.description:
Optional parameters for the notification channel.
Example: {"additional_properties": {"ttl": "3600"}} for a 1-hour time-to-live (actual support depends on Google API).
params.human_parameter_description: Extra settings for the notification channel, if needed. Most users can leave this empty.

spaces.title: Spaces
spaces.description: A comma-separated list of spaces to query within the corpora. Supported values are 'drive' and 'appDataFolder'.
spaces.human_parameter_description: Which Drive spaces to monitor, separated by commas (e.g., drive, appDataFolder). Most users can leave this as 'drive'.

address.title: Address
address.description: The URL where notifications are to be delivered. Must be a publicly reachable HTTPS URL with a valid SSL certificate; HTTP, localhost, and private network endpoints are rejected by the API.
address.human_parameter_description: The web address where Drive should send change notifications. Use a publicly reachable HTTPS endpoint you manage.

drive_id.title: Drive Id
drive_id.description: The shared drive from which changes will be returned. If specified, change IDs will be specific to the shared drive.
drive_id.human_parameter_description: The ID of the specific shared drive you want to watch. Leave empty to watch the user's My Drive instead.

page_size.title: Page Size
page_size.description: The maximum number of changes to return per page.
page_size.human_parameter_description: How many change records to return per page when listing changes. Larger numbers reduce paging but may take longer to load.

expiration.title: Expiration
expiration.description: Timestamp in milliseconds since the epoch for when the channel should expire. If not set, channel may not expire or have a default expiration. Channels are invalidated after expiry; re-establish the watch with a new channel before or after expiration to avoid missed changes.
expiration.human_parameter_description: When the channel should stop sending notifications, in milliseconds since Jan 1, 1970. Leave blank to use the default or set a future time to auto-expire.

page_token.title: Page Token
page_token.description: The token for continuing a previous list request on the next page. This should be set to the value of 'nextPageToken' from the previous response or to the response from the getStartPageToken method. Persist this token per channel so change processing can resume correctly after restarts or interruptions.
page_token.human_parameter_description: If continuing from a previous changes list, paste the next page token here. Otherwise, leave this blank.

include_removed.human_parameter_description: Include notifications about items that were deleted or that you lost access to. Keep enabled if you want to track removals.

supports_all_drives.title: Supports All Drives
supports_all_drives.description: Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives. Recommended to set to true if driveId is used or if interactions with shared drives are expected.
supports_all_drives.human_parameter_description: Confirm that your setup can handle both My Drive and shared drives. Turn this on if you’re watching or interacting with shared drives.

restrict_to_my_drive.title: Restrict To My Drive
restrict_to_my_drive.description: Whether to restrict the results to changes inside the My Drive hierarchy. This omits changes to files like those in the Application Data folder or shared files not added to My Drive.
restrict_to_my_drive.human_parameter_description: Limit results to items within your My Drive only. Turn on to exclude shared drive and app data changes.

include_corpus_removals.title: Include Corpus Removals
include_corpus_removals.description: Whether changes should include the file resource if the file is still accessible by the user at the time of the request, even when a file was removed from the list of changes.
include_corpus_removals.human_parameter_description: Include items removed from the main listing but still accessible to you. Enable for a more complete picture of changes.

include_permissions_for_view.title: Include Permissions For View
include_permissions_for_view.description: Specifies which additional view's permissions to include in the response.
include_permissions_for_view.human_parameter_description: Which extra permission view to include in results. Use 'published' if you need permissions visible to anyone with the link.

bounds.description: The bounding box of the viewport within which to bias geocode results more prominently (e.g., '34.172684,-118.604794|34.236144,-118.500938'). This parameter will only influence, not fully restrict, results.

latlng.description: The latitude and longitude coordinates specifying the location for which you want the closest, human-readable address (e.g., '40.714224,-73.961452'). Provide for reverse geocoding.

region.title: Region
region.description: The region code, specified as a ccTLD ('top-level domain') two-character value. This parameter will only influence, not fully restrict, results from the geocoder.

address.title: Address
address.description: The street address or plus code that you want to geocode. Provide for geocoding (address to coordinates).

language.title: Language
language.description: The language in which to return results. If language is not supplied, the geocoder attempts to use the preferred language as specified in the Accept-Language header, or the native language of the domain from which the request is sent.

place_id.title: Place Id
place_id.description: The place ID of the place for which you wish to obtain the human-readable address. Provide for place ID geocoding.

components.title: Components
components.description: A components filter with elements separated by a pipe (|). E.g., 'postal_code:94043|country:US'. Used for geocoding, can be restrictive or biasing. Supplying only `components` without `address` may return ZERO_RESULTS for some queries.

result_type.title: Result Type
result_type.description: A filter of one or more address types, separated by a pipe (|) (e.g., 'street_address|locality'). Used for reverse geocoding and place ID geocoding.

location_type.title: Location Type
location_type.description: A filter of one or more location types, separated by a pipe (|) (e.g., 'ROOFTOP|RANGE_INTERPOLATED'). Used for reverse geocoding and place ID geocoding.

extra_computations.title: Extra Computations
extra_computations.description: Use this parameter to specify additional features in the response. Can select multiple values.

global_code.title: Global Code
global_code.description: Place's global (full) code, such as '9FWM33GV+HQ', representing an 1/8000 by 1/8000 degree area (~14 by 14 meters).

compound_code.title: Compound Code
compound_code.description: Place's compound code, such as '33GV+HQ, Ramberg, Norway', containing the suffix of the global code and replacing the prefix with a formatted name of a reference entity.

types.title: Types
types.description: Array of strings denoting the type of the returned geocoded element (e.g., 'street_address', 'locality', 'political').

geometry.title: Geometry
geometry.description: Contains location data including coordinates, location type, and viewport.

place_id.title: Place Id
place_id.description: A unique identifier that can be used with other Google APIs. The place ID uniquely identifies a place in the Google Places database.

plus_code.title: Plus Code
plus_code.description: An encoded location reference, derived from latitude and longitude coordinates, that represents an area.

partial_match.title: Partial Match
partial_match.description: Indicates that the geocoder did not return an exact match for the original request, though it was able to match part of the requested address. Partial matches most often occur for street addresses that do not exist within the locality.

formatted_address.title: Formatted Address
formatted_address.description: A string containing the human-readable address of this location.

address_components.title: Address Components
address_components.description: Array containing the separate components applicable to this address.

postcode_localities.title: Postcode Localities
postcode_localities.description: An array denoting up to 100 localities contained in a postal code. This is only present when the result is a postal code that contains multiple localities.

status.title: Status
status.description: Metadata indicating request success or failure. Possible values: 'OK', 'ZERO_RESULTS', 'OVER_DAILY_LIMIT', 'OVER_QUERY_LIMIT', 'REQUEST_DENIED', 'INVALID_REQUEST', 'UNKNOWN_ERROR'.

results.title: Results

name: Text Search

fieldMask.title: Field Mask
fieldMask.description: Comma-separated list of place fields to return. When omitted, defaults to displayName and formattedAddress (requests through your own connected Google Maps account also include priceLevel). Requesting priceLevel increases the price. Common fields include: displayName, formattedAddress, types, rating, userRatingCount, priceLevel, websiteUri, nationalPhoneNumber, internationalPhoneNumber, regularOpeningHours, location, photos, googleMapsUri, businessStatus, id. The 'places.' prefix is optional and will be added automatically. Use '*' for all fields (not recommended for performance/cost). Common aliases are supported: 'name'->displayName, 'address'->formattedAddress, 'url'/'website'->websiteUri, 'type'->types, 'phone'->nationalPhoneNumber. Invalid field names (e.g., places.phoneNumber instead of places.nationalPhoneNumber) cause errors. Many fields (rating, websiteUri, regularOpeningHours, nationalPhoneNumber) may be absent even when requested — handle nulls.

textQuery.title: Text Query
textQuery.description: Text query for searching places. Matched against place name, address, and category. Underspecified queries (missing city, region, or business type) yield empty or irrelevant results. Brand-name-only queries return multiple franchise branches — validate formattedAddress against the intended location.

Results may include CLOSED_PERMANENTLY or TEMPORARILY_CLOSED places — filter by businessStatus=OPERATIONAL. Include city/region and business type in textQuery to avoid empty or irrelevant results. Deduplicate using id or formattedAddress, not name alone. Throttle to ~1 req/s; OVER_QUERY_LIMIT (HTTP 429) requires exponential backoff.
